schema.description: A schema card for a table or dataset, holding data_col children as its column list.

col.description: One column row: a monospace name, a muted type tag, an optional primary-key marker, and an optional note.

pipeline.description: A horizontal flow of data_stage children with arrows between them, wrapping on narrow width.

stage.description: One pipeline stage chip: a label, with an optional technology line under it.

fact.description: A static figure worth remembering, shown large above its caption. Not data-bound.
